text:
ashwin: Quick timeline ping — we need to lock Q3 dedicated capacity milestones. Main asks: procurement ETA, rack smoke & PDU status, reservation IDs, and canary schedule. Who's owning each deliverable?

maria: Procurement update — PO submitted yesterday, vendor showing lead time 5–8w depending on parts. PO#: PO-3279. I tagged shipping group in the ticket.

jessica: On procurement side: PO-3279 is in queue. Vendor offered split-ship option (can prioritize a subset). Tentative ship window: 2026-05-14 → 2026-05-21. I put the expected ARR in TICKET-4521.

kevin: From platform reservations perspective: we can map shipments to reservation slots once SKU list is final. Current tentative mix: H100 x16, A800 x8. Need final SKUs to create RESV IDs.

lia: Runtime note — we need ~4d per SKU for kernel/quant smoke and image bake. Canary plan exists, just waiting on slot lock to schedule.

olivia: Rack power/cooling checks scheduled 2026-05-22. Facilities lead asked for PDU mapping from infra. @maria can you confirm? :eyes: 

maria: PDU map is attached to TICKET-4521. Heads up — rack-18 has ~3kW less headroom than we assumed, so we may need to move some loads or split capacity.

ashwin: If vendor can split ship, can we compress schedule by doing staggered canaries? Start A800 subset first, validate, then bring H100. Opinions?

kevin: Staggered canaries make sense. I'll create reservation IDs per shipment chunk once jess confirms split. Plan names: RESV-202605-A800 and RESV-202605-H100.

jessica: Vendor confirmed they can split. I'll push for A800-first packing and confirm by EOD Tue.

lia: Agree with stagger. I'll draft a mixed-fleet canary runbook (operator steps + smoke checklist) and share in #eng-runtime for review.

olivia: FYI opened INC ticket for PDU load testing: INC-5591. We'll need results before the H100 bring-up.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: INC-5591 by olivia — pdu-load-test.

ashwin: Action items (short):
- jessica: confirm split-ship by EOD Tue
- kevin: create reservation IDs + map to racks once SKUs final
- lia: draft runbook for mixed-fleet canary (share by Wed)
- olivia/maria: validate PDU headroom, escalate if remediation needed
Please ack and flag blockers.

maria: ack — I'll re-run PDU math with facilities and update TICKET-4521 by EOD Tue. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack — will create RESV IDs by tomorrow 12:00 PT and post mapping here.

jessica: ack — pinging vendor now, will update timeline in thread.

lia: ack — runbook draft incoming in #eng-runtime by Wed morning.

olivia: ack — facilities engaged, pushing for earlier slot if possible.

kevin: quick draft mapping (will finalize after SKUs):
```
RESV-202605-A800: rack-17 slots 1-8
RESV-202605-H100: rack-18 slots 1-16
```

ashwin: Perfect. If anyone hits an unexpected blocker (PDU, cable kit, or vendor slip), drop it here and we'll escalate to infra leads. Aim: lock milestones by Friday so PM can update roadmap. Thanks all. :pray:
